Options:
  -f, --force  Allow a normally refused worktree
  --detach  Detach the new HEAD
  -b BRANCH  Create a new branch
  -B BRANCH  Create or reset a branch
  --checkout  Populate the new working tree
  --no-checkout  Skip initial checkout
  --lock  Lock the new working tree
  --reason REASON  Describe why the worktree is locked
  -q, --quiet  Suppress progress messages
